title: The reworked selection ships: cleaner grips, a tag that never covers the knob, and a 3D mode you switch into by the rotate knob
goal: The selection mock was reworked with the user on 2026-10-24 (Selection, the primitive: docs/design/mocks/pages/lang-selection.html, section 03b and the section 01 card) but it was never built. Build it in the app at Next defaults: thinner, cleaner sizing grips, a name and size tag that never covers the rotate knob, and a 3D mode entered from a small cube chip beside the rotate knob, where edge pills tip and turn the layer and corner grips push it back or pull it forward, all staying the same size on screen however the layer is turned. It also has to work on small objects, where today the 3D handles crowd each other and all react at once.
notes: User, 2026-11-01 (intake): 'what happened to the rework on selection ux especially with 3d transforms?' Answer: the mock was reworked with the user on 2026-10-24 (eight lang-selection commits, 07:31 to 15:07) and no build task was filed, so the loop never knew. Keep the mock as is; a departure is a decision card with a marked screenshot.
acceptance: The mock is the floor (mocks-are-the-floor): build what lang-selection.html section 01 and section 03b show, at Next defaults, and compare side by side with the mock in the audit. Read the eight commits 234b2c61, fbfa5edf, 7dd43cd6, 4cbc6a8e, 81f44782, ab645be5, 188797b9, f91f0da4, 1737a360 (2026-10-24) for what was decided and why.

Flat selection: 2 px grip corners, the rotate knob on a stem to the knob's edge, nothing drawn on a grip, and the name and size tag below the frame (above-left when there is no room), never over the rotate knob.

A small cube chip beside the rotate knob swaps between the sizing grips and the 3D grips. It shows the grips you would switch to, never a lit 'on' state, and swapping back keeps the layer's turn and depth. Escape leaves 3D grips.

In 3D grips: any edge pill turns the layer both ways (up and down tip it, left and right turn it, whichever edge is grabbed), Shift snaps to 15 degrees; corner grips carry an in-out arrow and move the layer along depth; pushing back or pulling forward reads as depth (the shadow grows as it comes forward, the tag says forward or back). Nothing sits on the layer's content: no middle knob, no extra circle.

Grips, knob, chip, tag and outline stay one size on screen however the layer is turned or pushed back (the mock measured 16x16 corner and 18x8 edge grips at 600 back, the same as flat): they are drawn flat over the layer at its projected corners; only the content takes the 3D.

Small objects (folded in from on-a-small-picked-object-the-3d-turn-handles-are, the user's 2026-10-20 ask): on a picked 140x45 button, every grip, the knob and the chip have room and their own target; hovering one lights only that one; none sits on the component badge. MEASURED hit areas in the audit.
Every change is one undo step through History.perform; the transform values in the tool bar's Info popover update live; agents get the same through set_layer.

Walks: flat pick of a large and a small layer; swap to 3D grips; tip, turn and push back with each grip; Shift snapping; Escape; swap back keeps the turn; hover lights only one grip. A reel and side-by-side mock comparison in the audit under queue/audits/. focus-drill clean.
Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar (queue/bin/follow-up-bar.md), and written into this task's log if it does not.

log.note: 2026-11-01: a PROTOTYPE for the user's review extends this task: docs/design/mocks/pages/selection-transform.html (design site: Surfaces > Transform modes). The chip by the rotate knob becomes three choices: Size, 3D, Distort. Perspective is the document camera's (SceneCamera.perspective, one camera for all 3D layers), reached from the tool bar Info popover (presets None 20/45/90 and a slider with a small camera-cone picture, 'affects all 3D layers') and by Option-dragging an edge pill in 3D (dashed lines to the vanishing point while dragging). Keys move to Photoshop's: Option = from the centre, Cmd-drag edge = skew, Cmd-drag corner = distort (corner pins, non-destructive four-corner data rendered by the same CIPerspectiveTransform path 3D uses), Cmd-Opt-Shift-drag corner = keystone; Layer > Transform > Skew / Distort / Keystone / Turn in 3D / Reset Transform. Today Option-drag on a corner skews: that moves to Cmd. NOT yet approved: wait for the user's word in this log before building the perspective, distort and key changes; the rest of this task stands.

User, 2026-11-01, reviewing the transform modes prototype: grips look the SAME in every mode (white square corners, one white edge pill size, the white knob); a mode only ADDS controls (3D adds the perspective pill and a separate depth grip below the card), and the chip, cursor and hover label say what a grip does in that mode. Hover lights a grip (fill blue) but never grows it. Every control stays above the content and just off it (edge pills touch the outside of their edge; the chip row rises above a turned card). Generous hit areas (edge 48x24, corner r14, knob r15). Corners still resize and the knob still turns in 3D. This supersedes the 2026-10-24 mock where 3D swapped the grips for different ones.

User, 2026-11-01: the plain circle knob did not read as rotate. The knob carries a clockwise arrow (SF Symbols arrow.clockwise) in a 19 pt white circle, white on blue when lit, never grown; over it the pointer is a rotate cursor (curved double arrow). See the prototype.
User, 2026-11-01: the rotate knob hangs on a DOTTED stem like the depth grip's (2 on, 3 off), each stem starting just past its edge pill so pill and stem never overlap.

User, 2026-11-01: resize keys match what Mac users expect (Keynote, Pages, Freeform, Preview): a picture keeps its proportions on a corner drag (Constrain proportions on for images), a shape resizes freely, Shift constrains a shape (and frees a picture, as Photoshop does), Option resizes from the centre. Skew, distort and keystone have no Mac convention, so they take Photoshop's keys (Cmd edge, Cmd corner, Cmd-Opt-Shift corner). Keynote's Cmd-drag-to-rotate is NOT adopted: the knob rotates, and Cmd on a corner is distort. Write the final key table into docs/design/tools.md with this reasoning.

User, 2026-11-01, correction: Shift ALWAYS keeps proportions (Mac), it never frees a picture. A picture's corners keep proportions anyway; a picture is stretched one way by its edge pills. A shape's corners are free unless Shift. This replaces the earlier Photoshop-style Shift toggle for pictures. Today's app (CanvasPointerDrags.swift: aspect = resizeKeepsShapeByDefault ? !shift : shift) must change to: aspect = resizeKeepsShapeByDefault || shift.

User, 2026-11-01, FINAL on resize (supersedes the two earlier notes today): 'I consistently want the aspect ratio preserved, and almost never want to stretch something.' A corner drag keeps proportions for EVERY layer, picture or shape, in every mode but Distort; Shift + corner stretches freely; an edge pill stretches one way; Option resizes from the centre. In the app: CanvasPointerDrags.swift today has aspect = resizeKeepsShapeByDefault ? !shift : shift; it becomes aspect = !shift for corner handles (edge handles unchanged). Hover label on a corner: 'Resize · Shift stretch · Cmd distort'. This deliberately departs from Keynote's free-by-default shapes; the user's preference wins.

User, 2026-11-01: skew is reserved for its own mode. FINAL modes on the chip by the rotate knob: Size (corners resize keeping proportions, Shift stretches; edge pills stretch one way; knob turns; NO Cmd modifiers), 3D (adds tip and swing on the edge pills, the depth grip, the perspective pill; corners still resize, knob still turns), Skew & distort (edge pill = skew, the edge slides along its own line; corner = distort, moves freely; Shift + corner = keystone, the corner across mirrors it). Layer > Transform > Skew / Distort / Keystone each enter Skew & distort. The Cmd edge / Cmd corner / Cmd-Opt-Shift keys proposed earlier today are dropped. Today's Option-corner skew in the app goes away (Option = from the centre).

User, 2026-11-01, the transform model (FINAL, supersedes earlier notes where they differ): the chip reads in the order the operations apply: Size, Skew & distort, 3D. Skew & distort RESHAPE THE PICTURE ITSELF: stored as each corner's offset in the layer's own unturned plane (as a share of width and height, so a resize carries it). Turn, resize, move and 3D act on top of the reshaped picture. In Size and 3D the grips sit on a flat rectangle round the reshaped picture (its bounding box in its own plane), with a faint dotted outline of the reshape inside, so a skewed picture is handled like a new original; only Skew & distort puts its grips on the reshaped corners. The knob turns in every mode. Prototype: docs/design/mocks/pages/selection-transform.html (Surfaces > Transform modes); verified in WebKit with real drags.
